title: Hardcoded Packet ID Lint Check
summary: Implement a mechanical guard against the recurring stale hardcoded packet-id bug family. The MCP bridge now includes scripts/check-hardcoded-packet-ids.mjs and scripts/hardcoded-packet-id-allowlist.json. The lint scans src/**/*.ts for FP-* and FP-MCP-* references, compares observed references against an explicit baseline allowlist, and fails on any new or changed source reference until it is reviewed and allowlisted with a reason. package.json now includes lint:packet-ids and test now runs pnpm build followed by pnpm lint:packet-ids. Verification passed: pnpm test completed successfully and reported 166 observed source references matched the allowlist. Bridge commit a3c99b9 records the implementation.
caveats: This is a baseline guard, not a full semantic proof that every existing hardcoded packet id is safe.

Existing 166 source references are allowlisted as the FP-MCP-239 baseline; future packets should gradually replace broad baseline reasons with more specific legacy/schema/boundary justifications where useful.
The check intentionally fails on changed line text as well as new references, forcing review when a hardcoded packet-id context changes.
The lint covers src/**/*.ts only; docs, generated dist files, and evidence artifacts are intentionally excluded.
This packet does not change runtime authorization behavior, runner start behavior, approval consumption, or clearance policy.

lintPolicy.allowlistKey: file + id + trimmed lineText, counted as a multiset
failureModes: changed packet-id line text not represented in allowlist
stale allowlist entry no longer observed
lintPolicy.standingRule: Any hardcoded FP-* or FP-MCP-* packet id inside generalized gate, approval, clearance, runner, or recorder logic is presumptively a bug unless explicitly allowlisted with a reason.

motivation.latestRootCause: recordHumanApprovalConsumption retained hardcoded expectedScope.packetId = FP-MCP-036 after the approval consumption scope generalized.
